title: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope Captures Eerie Cat’s Head
caption:
JWST’s infrared eye shows a feline nebula carved by powerful starlight. The dense core holds out, but the whole structure will eventually erode away. A snapshot of cosmic sculpting in action.

Source: Nasa - NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope Captures Eerie Cat’s Head
